description_en: Activates the pay-as-you-go Global Accelerator (GA) service. If you want to use pay-as-you-go GA instances, you must activate the pay-as-you-go GA service first
description_zh: 您如果使用全球加速后付费实例，必须开通全球加速后付费服务，该接口可用于开通全球加速后付费服务
name: OpenAcceleratorService

parameters.help_en: The region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。 
从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：表示调用成功。                                 
false：表示调用失败
